purposes.seed: Makes board colours repeatable between reviews.
purposes.board_count: Controls how finely divided the metre-wide wall appears.
purposes.seam_metres: Width of recessed board joins; backed by solid timber, never a see-through crack.
purposes.edge_bevel_metres: Small edge wear that catches daylight without changing the collision envelope.
purposes.colour_variation: Restrained per-board light/dark variation, as a fraction of the existing timber palette.
purposes.frame_fraction: Rail height as a fraction of wall height; keeps top and bottom joins legible.
purposes.roughness: Keeps timber matte in daylight instead of looking varnished.
purposes.grain_strength: Contrast of baked long wood fibres; restrained enough to read as timber rather than stripes.
